0022600190.text: The Atlanta Hawks (6-4) host the Brooklyn Nets (2-6) in the Hawks' 11th game of the season. Atlanta is first in the Southeast and fourth in the East, has won three straight, and is 2-2 at home and 4-2 on the road, while Brooklyn is 13th in the East, fifth in the Atlantic and five games back, and has won its last game after going 2-6 over its last ten. Atlanta is without Asa Newell (toe), Henri Veesaar (knee), Jalen Johnson (ankle), Jock Landale (hip), Keshon Gilbert (knee inflammation) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), and Brooklyn is without Egor Demin (leg bruise) and Tyler Bilodeau (shoulder sprain), with Noah Clowney listed as day-to-day with an illness and a game-time decision. The Hawks won all four meetings in the 2025-26 season series, most recently 141-107 in Brooklyn on April 3, 2026, and there are no games yet in the 2026-27 season series.
